name: Strength
description: Strength {value}: Increases attack damage by {value}.
notes: Value can be negative; negative values reduce attack damage.

name: Dexterity
description: Dexterity {value}: Increases Block gained from cards by {value}.
notes: Value can be negative; negative values reduce Block gained.

name: Weak
description: Weak {value}: Reduces attack damage by 25% for {value} turn(s).
notes: Stacks only increase duration; the 25% reduction remains constant.

name: Vulnerable
description: Vulnerable {value}: Increases attack damage taken by 50% for {value} turn(s).
notes: Stacks only increase duration; the 50% increase remains constant.

name: Frail
description: Frail {value}: Reduces Block gained from cards by 25% for {value} turn(s).
notes: Stacks only increase duration; the 25% reduction remains constant.

name: Entangled
description: Entangled: Cannot play Attack cards this turn.

name: Angry
description: Angry {value}: Whenever you take attack damage, gain {value} Strength.

name: Curl Up
description: Curl Up {value}: The next time you take attack damage, gain {value} Block (once per combat).

name: Rage
description: Rage {value}: Whenever the player plays a Skill card, gain {value} Strength.

name: Mode Shift
description: Mode Shift {value}: After taking {value} damage, transform into defensive mode.
notes: Switches immediately when the damage threshold is reached. Threshold can be permanently increased by certain moves.

name: Split (Acid)
description: When HP is at or below 50%, forces the next turn's intent to Split (Acid).

name: Split (Spike)
description: When HP is at or below 50%, forces the next turn's intent to Split (Spike).

name: Split+
description: When HP is at or below 50%, forces the next turn's intent to Split+.

name: Spore Cloud
description: Spore Cloud {value}: On death, apply {value} turns of Vulnerable to the player.

name: Sharp Hide
description: Sharp Hide {value}: Whenever the player plays an Attack card, take {value} damage.

name: Steal
description: Steal {value}: On attack, steal {value} gold from the player.

name: Gold
description: Gold {value}: On death, drop {value} gold.
notes: Gold amount can be increased by Steal.

name: Metallicize
description: Metallicize {value}: At the end of its turn, gain {value} Block.

name: Ritual
description: Ritual {value}: At the end of its turn, gain {value} Strength.

name: Artifact
description: Artifact {value}: Negates the next {value} debuff(s).
notes: Each stack negates one application of a debuff. Stacks decrease by 1 each time a debuff is blocked.
